Name: Keep Christmas Well
Author: thebigjb
Description:
[center][i][color=#b6d7a8][size=3][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/205777536-1724455057.png[/img]

"And it was always said of him that he knew how to keep Christmas well."
- A Christmas Carol
[/size][/color][/i]*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*[/center]

I LOOOOOVE Christmas and what started out as wanting to have candy canes that were [i]actually [/i]red and green became this mod. I wanted to do something to not just recolor in-game assets, but offer more decorations options for players in celebration of the Festival of the Winter Star.

Most of these items already exist in the game, you just can't buy them! Now you can!

This is my most involved mod to date and I'm incredibly proud of it. It incorporates so many things I've never tried before.

I hope you love it and it brings you joy!

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/205777536-1724455214.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*]After installing, the first time you wake on Fall 24 you will have a new message from Robin with a new festive fence recipe.
[*]Every year from Fall 24 to Winter 28, Robin sells nearly 60 new holiday items . [i](I recommend trying the Happy Snowman and keep an eye on him.)[/i]
[*]Robin sends you a reminder about the sale every Fall 24th. 
[/list]
[i]Mods In Screenshots:

The owl is a mailbox is from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24758]Kari's Delivery Service - Seasonal Mailbox[/url]﻿
My farmhouse appearance is from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1993]Elle's Seasonal Buildings[/url]﻿[/i]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/205777536-1724455177.png[/img]
